question.stem: Which of the following findings would require immediate follow-up?

options.text: difficulty focusing due to blurred vision

question.footnote: © NCSBN. Taken from https://www.nclex.com/prepare.page; click on 'Download Exam Preview'.
question.preamble: The nurse has administered haloperidol to a client with schizophrenia who is agitated.
question.explanation: Muscle stiffness after a high-potency typical antipsychotic like haloperidol raises concern for an acute extrapyramidal reaction (dystonia) or early neuroleptic malignant syndrome, both of which require immediate follow-up. Lack of motivation (Option 1) and inappropriate emotional expressions (Option 3) are negative/baseline symptoms of schizophrenia, not acute medication emergencies. Blurred vision (Option 4) is a common, less dangerous anticholinergic side effect.
